definitions.explanation: A work that continues or follows up on a previous work, such as a book, movie, game, or TV series.

examples.japanese: {続編|ぞくへん}が{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to the sequel.

examples.japanese: あの{映画|えいが}の{続編|ぞくへん}が{来年|らいねん}{公開|こうかい}される。
examples.english: The sequel to that movie will be released next year.

examples.japanese: {大|だい}ヒットした{小説|しょうせつ}の{続編|ぞくへん}が{期待|きたい}を{裏切|うらぎ}らない{出来|でき}だった。
examples.english: The sequel to the hugely popular novel lived up to expectations.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used for movies, novels, manga, anime, and video games. Can also refer to non-fiction sequels or follow-up reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {続編|ぞくへん}が{出|で}る: a sequel comes out
- {続編|ぞくへん}を{制作|せいさく}する: to produce a sequel
- {待望|たいぼう}の{続編|ぞくへん}: long-awaited sequel
- {続編|ぞくへん}{決定|けってい}: sequel confirmed

SIMILAR WORDS:
{続|つづ}き (continuation) is more casual and can refer to the continuation of anything, not just creative works. {第|だい}2{作|さく} (second installment) is a more neutral term. {続編|ぞくへん} specifically implies a new work that follows up on a previous one.
